message:
`this` should be an `{expression}`. Using a string attribute value will cause an error in future versions of Svelte
https://svelte.dev/e/svelte_element_invalid_this
frame:
1: <svelte:options namespace="svg" />
2: <svelte:element this="svg" viewBox="0 0 10 10" />
                             ^
3: <svelte:element this="svg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 10 10" />
4: <svg viewBox="" />
